name: Maniwa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Maniwa city emblem in white: a stylised swirl of a ring with feather-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Maniwa, a city in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2005.

features.role: Maniwa city emblem — a stylised swirl of a ring with feather-like strokes
